## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-review-cycles-end-to-end.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Test drives all 3 touchpoints sequentially against single artifact
- [ ] Final cycles[] length == 3 with n=1, n=2, n=3
- [ ] Single ticket comment referencing artifact path (no duplication)
- [ ] Artifact is valid JSON at each intermediate step
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-review-cycles-end-to-end.sh → PASS
